name: Amazon tree boa
desc: Eats a wide range of prey, including frogs, lizards, birds and mammals such as bats. GloBI records it eating a sac-winged bat.
about: Corallus hortulana, previously known as Corallus hortulanus, and commonly known as the Amazon tree boa, common tree boa, garden tree boa, and macabrel, is a boa species found in South America.
